title: Loop+ Tenure Courtesy Rates for Marketplace Orders Replacement Charges
content:
**Rates.** The tenure courtesy of the Marketplace Orders replacement charge counts the whole calendar months from the Loop+ membership's start date to the settlement date, for a membership in good standing only: at least the long-tenure months of 48 earn the long-tenure rate of 0.05 (5%); at least the mid-tenure months of 24 but fewer than 48 earn the mid-tenure rate of 0.025 (2.5%); fewer months, or no membership in good standing, earn no tenure courtesy.

The tenure courtesy rate is added to any other Loop+ courtesy rate the membership earns on the charge; the combined rate is applied once to the charged item amount, rounded half up to the cent, and deducted from the replacement charge.

The record read is the buyer's Loop+ Membership: its status (good standing means trial, active, payment hold or cancel pending) and its start date.

| Whole months from start date to settlement date (good standing) | Tenure courtesy rate |
|---|---|
| 48 or more | 5% |
| 24 to 47 | 2.5% |
| 0 to 23 | none |
| membership not in good standing | none |

## Hypothetical cases

1. A membership started on 10 March four years before a settlement on 9 March: 47 whole months, 2.5%. Settled on 10 March: 48 whole months, 5%.
2. A lapsed membership started ten years earlier: not in good standing, no tenure courtesy.
3. With a charged item amount of USD 36.00 and a combined Loop+ courtesy rate of 2.5% only, the courtesy is 0.90 deducted.
